source.inspectionScope: Full rendered creation-to-final timeline and all34 submitted inline messages, including historical versions. Safe paraphrase only. No restricted or personal payload.
source.limitations: Bug1715361 comments1,6,7,8,24,26,29,31 remain unavailable; entries1113/1118/1120 are not fully audited. No runtime, visual or formal contrast validation.

text:
CSS parsing: The reviewer proposed HTMLStyleElement.sheet instead of regex for distinguishing color and background-color. The author adopted parsed rules and shared sanitizeStyle with inline styles. See D225298#inline-1257876 and #inline-1259943.

Document readiness: The reviewer accepted while still reporting intermittent getComputedStyle argument errors and asking whether MsgLoaded was too early. The author then added a documentElement guard. That guard is an applied change; the event-timing theory remains a hypothesis.

Module global: Review questioned a system module for a DOM helper. The author agreed to a plain module. Inline1259903 requested a separate lazy getter with global:"current"; the landing applies it. Calendar and task use was a future plan, not an inspected caller.

Acceptance limits: Image processing, about:blank flashes and further stylesheet detection were left out or deferred. The reviewer accepted remaining misses as readable. The author later described the threshold as guaranteeing AA readability; this study does not establish that claim or formal contrast compliance.
title: DarkReader applied review decisions and unresolved limits
